title: The Exercise of the Spatial Imagination in Pre-Modern China
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: This volume is distinctive for its extraordinarily interdisciplinary investigations into a little discussed topic, the spatial imagination. It probes the exercise of the spatial imagination in pre-modern China across five general areas: pictorial representation, literary description, cartographic mappings, and the intertwining of heavenly and earthly space.
